title: Record or correct equipment event
purpose: Append calibration or maintenance evidence or replace a mistaken event with a linked correction.
summary: Record a calibration or maintenance event for an asset, or replace a mistaken event with a linked correction.

tasks.title: Record a calibration or maintenance
steps: Choose a staff performer or enter the outside provider.
Choose the [[Outcome]] and, if the lab has set one, the [[Next due]] date, then save.

tasks.title: Correct an earlier event
steps: Change the values that were wrong.
Explain the change in [[Correction reason]] and save. The original stays on record, marked Corrected.

good_to_know: Maintenance outcomes are Completed or Not acceptable. A new form starts on Acceptable, which is valid only for calibration.
A Not acceptable outcome shows a warning. It does not open a nonconformance or take the asset out of service.
Entering an older event does not replace the latest one shown as current.
Retired assets cannot take new events. An already-corrected event cannot be corrected again; correct the newer one.

sections.title: Access and variants
paragraphs: Admin, analyst and reviewer roles may record events on In service or Out of service assets. Retired assets reject events; change status first if appropriate. Record calibration and Record maintenance preselect Kind but leave it editable. A generic event link shows Record event. Correct event preloads the original values, fixes Kind and requires Correction reason. An already-corrected event redirects with an error; correct the newer event. The original record stays unchanged.

items.label: Kind
items.description: Required: Calibration or Maintenance. Disabled on correction. Generic new-event forms initially show Calibration.

items.label: Performed on
items.description: Required date, default today for new events; cannot be future.

items.label: Performed by (staff)
items.description: Optional active non-client account. At least this or an outside provider is required. If both are supplied, the table displays the staff name.

items.label: Performed by (outside provider)
items.description: Optional provider name, maximum 160 characters; needed when no staff performer is chosen.

items.label: Outcome
items.description: Required. Calibration permits Acceptable or Not acceptable; maintenance permits Completed or Not acceptable. The form can show all choices, but an incompatible combination is rejected. New forms initially show Acceptable, including a preselected Maintenance form, so choose Completed or Not acceptable for maintenance.

items.label: Reference
items.description: Optional certificate, work order, procedure or standard reference, maximum 160 characters.

items.label: Description
items.description: Optional account of work, standards or parts used.

items.label: Next due
items.description: Optional lab-set date; cannot precede Performed on. Blank leaves no scheduled date for this event. No interval is suggested.

items.label: Evidence file
items.description: Optional validated attachment; choose a new file for a correction if needed.

items.label: Correction reason
items.description: Correction only; required explanation kept with the replacement and in audit history.

sections.title: Saving and current state
paragraphs: Submission appends a record and returns to asset details. The latest uncorrected event by performed date, then ID, supplies current due/outcome, so entering an older event does not necessarily replace the displayed latest one. Correction and asset status are rechecked under locks; simultaneous attempts to correct the same event cannot both succeed. Not acceptable shows a warning to consider opening a nonconformance, without automatically creating it or changing asset status.

sections.title: Evidence files
paragraphs: Attach a nonempty PDF, PNG, JPEG, TXT or CSV no larger than 10 MiB. TXT/CSV must be UTF-8; PDF and image bytes must match the extension. Evidence is optional unless a step requires a reference or file. Downloads are attachments, not inline previews. File links show name, size and the first 12 SHA-256 checksum characters. No file indicates no stored attachment. Staff can download equipment/nonconformance evidence; training evidence is limited to the person and lead roles. A correction is a new record: an earlier attachment is not copied automatically, so attach evidence again if it belongs on the new record.

sections.title: Saving and errors
paragraphs: An asterisk marks required fields. Cancel returns to the parent record or list without saving. Success opens the saved record with a confirmation. Validation errors appear above the form and beside affected fields; correct them and submit again. Text input remains after validation errors; select an evidence file again if necessary. Dates use year-month-day; date and time fields use the deployment time zone.

sections.title: Form dialog controls
paragraphs: With enhancement enabled, the form opens in a dialog, including when its URL is opened directly. Without enhancement it remains a normal page. While loading or saving, controls are disabled to avoid duplicate submissions; focus moves to the first invalid field or first editable field when ready. Saving successfully navigates to the resulting record.

items.label: Maximize / Restore size
items.description: Expand the dialog to full screen or restore its normal size. Small screens use a full-screen layout.

items.label: Cancel / Close form / Escape
items.description: Close an unchanged form. When opened over another page, return focus to its opening control; when opened directly, return to the Cancel destination. Clicking outside the dialog does not close it.

items.label: Keep editing / Discard changes
items.description: After an input change, attempting to leave asks Discard your unsaved changes? Keep editing retains the form; Discard changes closes or follows the requested destination without saving. Escape during that prompt keeps editing.

items.label: Try again
items.description: Shown after a failed initial load. Retry loading the form. Save/connection errors keep the current input and show an error so you can retry the submission. Validation errors replace the form with its submitted values and field messages; files may need selecting again.
